reference: 9 source subjects equal weight; common source-only images; no target labels
source_trial: first stored single trial per image
ridge_objective: Frobenius squared residual / n + lambda ||W||_F^2; unpenalized intercept
internal_split: 80/20 nested fixed seed permutation; dev-gallery excludes fit images
selection: development mean rank; tie chooses larger lambda
evaluation: 200 disjoint test images; average raw predictions after singletrial inference
paper_reproduction: CORAL formula transfer and LoRA mechanism; not paper benchmark scores
